settings.title: Full-Option Industrial Glass Washing Machine 1600mm – Iranian Model

settings.text:
Several machines are required to produce double-glazed glass for use in the UPVC industry. One of the most important is the full-option glass washing machine, also known as an industrial glass washer.
Today, some double-glazing workshops wash glass manually without using a machine.
However, the slow speed of manual washing, together with the need for cleanliness and competitiveness in the market, makes the use of an industrial glass washer increasingly important.
The Iranian-made 1600mm full-option glass washing machine is a popular model on the market. It eliminates the need for manual glass cleaning and delivers the highest level of quality.

settings.title: What Is a Double-Glazed Glass Washing Machine?
settings.text:
In a double-glazed glass production workshop where double-glazed and UPVC doors and windows are assembled, many industrial machines are used. These include:
• Spacer bending machine
• Vertical glass washing and pressing machine
• Horizontal glass washing machine
• Gas filling machine
• Rotary table
• Glass cutting table
• Butyl applicator
• Polysulfide sealant applicator
The industrial glass washer is one of the most important machines in the double-glazing production process. It is available in horizontal and vertical models.
Its benefits include high operating speed, ease of use, improved final product quality, reasonable pricing, and easy replacement of parts and spare components.

settings.title: How Does an Industrial Glass Washing Machine Work?
settings.text:
The double-glazed glass washing machine consists of several sections.
At the machine inlet, a set of rollers feeds the glass into the machine. The glass then passes through washing brushes and water sprays, which clean its surface.
After washing, the machine's felt rollers remove the water. Finally, the drying fan dries the glass, which is then delivered by the outlet rollers.
It is worth noting that double-glazed glass washing machines are generally manufactured with four or six brushes, a factor that has a significant effect on washing quality.

settings.title: Important Considerations Before Buying a Double-Glazed Glass Washing Machine
settings.text:
As explained above, double-glazed glass washing machines play an important role in the production of these products.
Without this equipment, washing the glass manually can significantly reduce the quality of the final products.
For this reason, an industrial glass washer is essential. Several important factors should be considered when purchasing one:
Double-glazed glass washing machines are classified according to glass thickness and maximum glass dimensions. As the glass dimensions increase, the machine price also rises.
The number, type, and bristle density of the brushes are important selection criteria. Brushes with denser bristles generally clean glass more effectively. They must also be designed to prevent scratches on the glass.
The pressure applied by the brushes to the glass must be adjustable.
The machine body in the washing area and the water tanks must be made of rust-resistant materials, as these areas are exposed to severe corrosion.
Moving components, especially bearings exposed to moisture, must be selected in accordance with applicable standards to prevent wear, corrosion, and excessive noise over time.
The machine should use filters to clean the water. Water becomes contaminated over time, and without filtration, washing quality will deteriorate.
A heating element for the water tank is essential. The ideal temperature for washing and degreasing glass is 35°C; particularly in winter, this temperature cannot be maintained without a heating element.
Make sure to check the quality of the rollers before purchasing.
One of the most common problems with many glass washing machines on the market, particularly low-quality Chinese models, is their inability to dry the lower part of the glass. We therefore recommend the 1600mm full-option glass washing machine, whose drying fan motor has high power and which washes both sides of the glass simultaneously.
Choose a machine that comes with a reliable warranty and after-sales service to avoid potential losses in the event of a malfunction.
